subject: Compact tech run-through — please confirm one tight morning slot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlayerhealth.com>; Elena Ortiz <eortiz@brightlayerhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + propose compact tech walkthrough

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery: BrightLayer is focused on reducing per-call latency for clinical note generation, wants predictable inference costs, and needs SSO + HIPAA alignment for pilot data. Big red flags were the 90ms tail spikes on your current endpoint and lack of prefix caching for repeated patient prompts.

Next step: instead of a long demo, can we run a focused 15–20 minute technical run-through where Ben shows our latency profile, caching behavior, and a quick SSO checklist? I have three compact morning windows below — these are tight (we're trying to get a slot this week):

- Wed 5/6 — 09:15–09:35 PT
- Thu 5/7 — 08:45–09:05 PT
- Fri 5/8 — 09:00–09:20 PT

Please reply with the exact slot that works and confirm within 4 hours so I can lock Ben's calendar. If none work, say your preferred morning and we'll try to accommodate. Attaching the discovery notes and a pre-demo checklist.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Neha Kapoor
Redwood Inference

Also, could you include a brief note on SSO and expected log retention for the pilot? Our security lead will glance through it before the call.

Thanks,
